IKAR LTD is a global leader with 30+ years
of experience in the textile industry, manufacturing intimates, athleisure,
and performance wear.

Specializing in cutting-edge R&D, design, and technical solutions for superior quality and fit. IKAR’s mission is to enable apparel brands to become category leaders by delivering innovative, sustainable, and competitive solutions.

June  5th, 2025

Ultra-Fine 40GG Knitting × ECONYL® brand®
Pairing 40-gauge Santoni seamless knitting with ECONYL® regenerated microfiber yarns - crafted from post-consumer waste - yields an exceptionally soft, barely-there feel. The result: highly flexible, adaptive fabrics designed for elevated everyday comfort.

These seamless textiles deliver both high-performance and sustainability, embodying technical excellence without compromising luxury or durability. A perfect choice for premium intimates and activewear collections that prioritize innovation and responsibility.

IKAR LinkedIn

May 29th, 2025

Hybrid Innovation for High-Performance Outerwear

Innovation is never one-dimensional.
Our newest extra-warm mid-layer hybrid jacket integrates Seamless and Cut & Sew technologies to deliver the optimal balance of structure, flexibility, and thermal efficiency.
Developed using 3D design tools, it reflects our commitment to smarter, faster, and more responsible product development.

🔹 Hybrid construction – Targeted warmth, engineered mobility
🔹 Tech integration – Seamless meets cut & sew for elevated function
🔹 Thoughtful design – Built with durability and efficiency in mind

Innovation, redefined. Performance, elevated. By IKAR.

IKAR LinkedIn

May 15th, 2025

Natural Dyeing in Seamless Production 🌱
At IKAR, we’re proud to lead sustainable innovation by integrating natural dyeing techniques into our seamless production.

For several collections, we’ve embraced Tea Dye - an eco-friendly method using natural extracts sourced from the iced tea industry. The result? Beautiful, earthy tones with a significantly lower environmental impact.

By reducing chemical usage, we take one more step toward a cleaner, greener future in fashion.

IKAR LinkedIn

May 8th, 2025

Natural, Organic, Plant-Based Yarns 🌿
Today, we are choosing more natural solutions - in beauty, food, fashion, and nearly every part of life.
At IKAR, we bring this shift to life by using natural and plant-based yarns in our latest intimates and activewear collections - without compromising on performance, comfort, or style.

Our natural and botanical-origin materials offer breathability, softness, and functionality. We also embrace natural dyeing techniques and incorporate plant-based, non-metal antibacterial solutions to create a more mindful and eco-friendly finish.

Our AI-generated visuals reflect this innovation—but this is not just a concept.
The future of fashion is natural. And at IKAR, it’s already here.

Reach out to explore our latest Natural Performance collections.

April 3th, 2025

New seamless state-of-the-art operations in Cambodia & Vietnam 🌍

We’re excited to announce the expansion of our operations in Vietnam and the launch of new operations in Cambodia. We have established new IKAR seamless hubs that enhance our manufacturing flexibility and supply chain resilience. This strategic expansion allows us to better serve our partners worldwide, ensuring greater capacity - adding 3 million units a month, adaptability, and competitiveness in an ever-evolving market.
By strengthening our presence in these key regions, we continue to provide high-quality seamless solutions while optimizing our global operations to meet the growing demands of our industry.

As always, innovation, sustainability, and performance are at the core of everything we do.

IKAR LinkedIn

March 20th, 2025

Global Recycling Day –  Closing the Loop on Textile Waste! ♻🌍

​

Global Recycling Day occurred on March 18, and at IKAR sustainability is a core value. Every year, 92 million tons of textile waste pollute our planet, harming valuable resources. 

We are on a mission to reduce our ecological footprint, raising the bar continuously! 

Today we are offering new diverse technologics; one of them is Loop Tech -  transforming end-of-life of polyamide 6 into high-quality recycled → raw materials → yarns →  fabrics → new products.

We give new life to materials that would otherwise be discarded, reducing waste and promoting true circularity in the textile industry. 

​

♻ Together, we are making a true impact!

🌍✨ Highlighting Sustainability and Innovation at Performance Days ✨🌍

​

Last week’s Performance Days in Munich showcased exciting advancements in the world of circular knitting, with a strong emphasis on sustainability.

We were thrilled to be part of the event, where innovations in recycled yarns, seamless technology, and eco-friendly fabric development took center stage, demonstrating the industry’s commitment to a more sustainable future.

​

We look forward to embracing these innovations and continuing our journey toward a more circular and sustainable industry.

February 20th, 2025

Organic Cotton: Soft, Sustainable & Skin-Friendly

At IKAR, we believe in fabrics that not only feel good but also do good. Organic cotton is one great example—and that’s why we offer unique fabrications incorporating GOTS-certified organic cotton yarns, ensuring the highest sustainability standards.

✔ No Harmful Chemicals – Grown without synthetic pesticides or fertilizers.
✔ Less Water, Healthier Soil – Supports soil health and conserves resources.
✔ Gentle on Skin – Free from harsh chemicals, making it ideal for sensitive skin.
✔ Biodegradable & Ethical – Naturally decomposes and is responsibly sourced.

Sustainability isn’t just a trend—it’s our commitment.

October 10th, 2024

October is Breast Cancer Awareness Month, and at IKAR Group, we believe in standing strong for the cause. 💗 🎗 

​

As we continue to invest and develop innovative bras, we are reminded of the strength and resilience of those battling breast cancer.
Early detection and support are key to increasing survival rates - when caught early, the 5-year relative survival rate can be as high as 99%.
Let’s take action by encouraging regular screenings and spreading awareness.


Together, we can make a difference. 

​
